title: Delivery room
description: A hospital labour and delivery room with a birthing bed, medical equipment and a baby warmer, a family sofa under the windows, a privacy curtain and an attached bathroom.

tasks.text: Facing the cabinets behind the head of the bed, pick up the single loose cup just in front of the stack of cups on the left cabinet. Set it on the clear right half of the wheeled overbed table, at the end away from its support column.

locatorSteps.label: Pick up the loose cup in front of the stack.
Set it on the clear right half of the overbed table.

tasks.text: Find the cup already on the wheeled overbed table. Push it 20 cm along the tabletop from the support-column side toward the clear right end, keeping it on the table.

locatorSteps.label: Push the cup 20 cm toward the clear right end.

tasks.text: On the bed’s right rail, count the four buttons from the foot of the bed toward the head. Press the first to raise the bed fully, the third to raise the backrest fully, the fourth to return the backrest to flat, and the second to lower the bed to its starting height.

locatorSteps.label: From the foot, press button 1 to raise the bed.
Press button 3 to raise the backrest.
Press button 4 to lower the backrest flat.
Press button 2 to lower the bed fully.

tasks.text: Face the drawer beneath the newborn warmer’s bassinet and heat lamp. Press the left foot pedal to raise the warmer, pull the drawer containing two supply boxes fully open, then close it. Press the right pedal to lower the warmer, keeping the boxes in place.

locatorSteps.label: Raise the warmer with the left foot pedal.
Pull the loaded drawer fully open.
Close the drawer with the boxes inside.
Lower the warmer with the right pedal.

tasks.text: At the cart with two stacked displays beside the head of the bed, pull the top drawer fully open. From the drawer side, tilt the upper display toward you, then close the drawer all the way.

locatorSteps.label: Pull the top drawer fully open.
Tilt the upper display toward the drawer side.
Close the top drawer fully.

tasks.text: Fold the bathroom shower’s wall-mounted seat up against the wall. Slide the handheld shower head to the top of its rail, then fold the seat back down to its horizontal position.

locatorSteps.label: Fold the wall seat up.
Slide the shower head to the top of its rail.
Fold the seat back down to horizontal.

tasks.text: Slide the bathroom door fully closed. Pull down on the low handle of the nurse-call rope between the toilet and the shower, release it so it returns to rest, then slide the door fully open again.

locatorSteps.label: Slide the bathroom door fully closed.
Pull down on the low call handle.
Release the handle and let it return.
Slide the bathroom door fully open.

tasks.text: On the wheeled overbed table with a cup on top, press and hold the release lever under the tabletop near its support column. Raise the tabletop fully, then let go of the lever so the top stays locked at the raised height.

locatorSteps.label: Hold the release lever beneath the tabletop.
Raise the tabletop fully while holding the lever.
Release the lever to lock the raised top.

tasks.text: Lift the swaddle blanket lying on the bassinet mattress beneath the heat lamp. Draw it toward the foot of the bassinet and release it on the mattress, spread over at least 60% of the mattress length.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the swaddle off the bassinet mattress.
Draw the blanket toward the foot of the bassinet.
Release it over at least 60% of the mattress length.

tasks.text: Lift the folded towel off the lower of the two bathroom shelves above the towel rack. Unfold it and hold it out in front of the shelf so the whole towel hangs freely.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the towel off the lower bathroom shelf.
Unfold the towel.
Hold it clear of the shelf so it hangs freely.
